notes: This contract pins the private Annex C.4 dimension-composition rule. Same-name dimensions are compared with the first definition: an identical duplicate is ignored, while any differing name/data type/upperBound/normalization/value/notes sub-element fails composition. Equivalent referenced note content remains stable across Umbra's per-module note-label remapping, and unique dimension names are inserted. This is source/test traceability only, not a public FOM conformance claim.
